channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Nvidia Stock Plunges After Jensen Huang Resigns as CEO
item.description: News that the chipmaker’s chief executive, Jensen Huang, stepped down drove Nvidia’s stock down and reverberated across global markets.

item.title: NPR: Democrats want to stop Trump's arch, golf course and more. What are their options?
item.description: As Trump's arch and other projects make their way through the courts, many critics are looking to Congress to stop them. Democrats have a few tools, including funding and oversight.

item.title: BBC News: Zoe Kleinman: How AI visionary Jensen Huang was undone by his own bad decisions
item.description: Zoe Kleinman explains how the man who built Nvidia from the ground up lost everything in a matter of days.

item.title: The Guardian: You can see everything on this list: the 20 most jaw-dropping documentaries – ranked!
item.description: Ahead of the UK release of Nathan Fielder’s hotly anticipated Elizabeth Holmes film, we count down the most shocking and affecting true stories ever committed to cinema A 50-second dispatch from daily life blew the whist…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Al Jazeera reports from Gaza hospital attacked by Israel
item.description: Al Jazeera’s Tareq Abu Azzoum reports on the aftermath of an Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital

item.title: Ars Technica: Netflix releases new trailer for Ray Gunn
item.description: "It's hard being the only honest players in a crooked game."

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: China’s Nvidia Honeypot Isn’t Surprising. Jensen Huang Fell for It Anyway
item.description: China’s use of sexpionage is a well-established intelligence tactic with recent, high-profile examples. So how did the world’s most powerful AI executive fall for it?

item.title: WIRED Science: Synchron Pauses Trials of Its Brain Implant Due to Performance Issues
item.description: After its latest device struggled to perform, brain-computer interface startup Synchon halted clinical trials. The company says it will upgrade the implant’s hardware and is at work on a new device.

item.title: WIRED Business: Google DeepMind Staff Tap the UK Government to Escalate Their Unionization Fight
item.description: After initial talks stalled, workers at Google DeepMind are trying to bypass company management in their bid to unionize.

item.title: The New Yorker: The Candidates Who Defeated the Politics of White Grievance
item.description: Will Democrats’ breakthrough in the South transform their party’s view of a winning campaign?
